problem.scope: Systems-coding design for getFileSize(uri) and fetch(uri,offset,length,buffer), then CachedFile.read. Nodes are in-process modules, synchronized data structures and the remote StorageClient interface. Compare one global access-order cache with sharded block ownership. Original signatures are long getFileSize(String uri) and void fetch(String uri, long offset, int length, byte[] buffer). With this interface the URI must be immutable or version-addressed and stable for the handle lifetime. A mutable source cannot guarantee snapshot-consistent multi-block reads through this interface. Conditional fetch and version metadata below are explicitly proposed adapter extensions, unsupported unless the provider adapter supplies them.
